responsibility: Runtime-independent helper implementation shared by all Objective-C runtime backends and objc-act.c for constructing metadata trees. It provides utilities to build structs, arrays, fields, variable declarations, constructors, selector references, method/ivar/module templates, ivar list initializers, protocol reference emission, and pooled metadata strings, while also holding the shared runtime tag tree table used by NeXT-style metadata so per-runtime files can focus on ABI-specific layouts and hooks.
same_name_distinction: Implementation side of the objc-runtime-shared-support pair: this .c file contains the shared metadata-building code used by ObjC runtimes and objc-act, such as constructing structs, fields, vars, selector references, ivar/method/module templates, protocol references, and emitted string tables. Unlike gcc/objc/objc-runtime-shared-support.h, it is the common helper implementation rather than the declaration surface consumed by runtime-specific files and the front end.
